description: NEW offline eval harness scripts/eval_lipika_crops.py (ITEM 2). Compares fp32 (lipika_script.onnx) vs int8 (lipika_script.int8.onnx) under three input strategies (A full-crop letterbox = current observer; B square-ish line windows; C lipika's own letterbox replicated in numpy/PIL) on real dataset word crops + Latin line crops rendered from English PDFs via FEAT-001's extractor. onnxruntime+numpy+OpenCV+PIL+fitz only; NO torch, NO fontrecog, NOT imported at runtime. Depends on FEAT-001 (uses extract_line_crops for Latin crops).
steps: Create scripts/eval_lipika_crops.py. Deps: onnxruntime, numpy, cv2, PIL, fitz, csv, argparse, json. Reuse `from src.ai.layer1_probe import imaging` and `from src.ai.layer1_probe.line_crops import extract_line_crops`. Do NOT import torch or fontrecog anywhere. Guard execution under `if __name__ == '__main__':`.

Manifest: accept optional --manifest CSV (columns source_path, kind, true_script[, page]; kind in {crop,pdf,image}). When absent, auto-build: one `crop` row per dataset/verified_twice/<lang>/cropped_images/*.jpeg mapped folder->script via the authoritative LANGUAGE->SCRIPT table (hindi/marathi->devanagari, assamese/bengali->bengali, punjabi->gurmukhi, gujarati->gujarati, kannada->kannada, malayalam->malayalam, odia->odia, tamil->tamil, telugu->telugu, urdu->arabic); skip __MACOSX and .DS_Store; plus `pdf` rows true_script=latin for the five English PDFs in dataset/ (MY_resume.pdf, Vinay_Resume.pdf, 'bert vs sas.pdf', missouri_water_sample.pdf, 'Chander Kochhar 01_compressed 2.pdf'). Sample balanced with --min-per-script (default 30) and --per-script-cap (default 150); report ACTUAL per-script counts; list+skip any folder/PDF that can't be mapped. NEVER use lipika/VLM to label.

Crop production: kind=crop -> load jpeg directly (already tight). kind=pdf -> fitz open, for each page rgb = imaging.render_rgb(page, 144), gray = imaging.analysis_gray(rgb, 144, 100), cut lines with extract_line_crops(gray) and take the matching region from full-res rgb. kind=image -> cv2 decode then same line-crop path.
Strategy A: replicate script_classifier._letterbox EXACTLY (white pad to max(h,w) square, cv2.resize INTER_CUBIC, astype float32/255, (x-mean)/std with mean 0 std 1, transpose to NCHW).

Strategy B: cut square-ish windows along each crop (aspect 1:1..2:1, slide/tile across the longer axis), letterbox each window as in A, run the model on all windows, mean the softmax across windows before argmax for that crop.

Strategy C: numpy/PIL replica of fontrecog.infer.predictor.letterbox (PIL convert RGB, pad to max(w,h) square fill=255, resize to 224 with Image.BICUBIC, np.array/255, transpose(2,0,1), add batch). Add a code comment + report note that fontrecog is NOT imported (its letterbox returns a torch.Tensor) and this is a faithful numpy replica.

Models: load BOTH src/ai/layer1_probe/models/lipika_script.onnx and lipika_script.int8.onnx via onnxruntime.InferenceSession(providers=['CPUExecutionProvider']); reuse ONE session per model across all strategies. Read labels from models/lipika_script.labels.json; collapse the three 'other' slots (indices 7,9,11) to a single 'other' class for accuracy + confusion matrix. If a model file is missing, warn+skip that model; if BOTH missing, exit non-zero.

Metrics per (strategy x model): per-script top-1 accuracy; FULL confusion matrix (rows=true, cols=pred, other collapsed); top1-top2 softmax margin distribution (min/median/mean/max or small histogram); page/source-level vote accuracy = argmax of MEAN softmax over each source's crops, reporting the minimum crop count N.

Output: write a markdown report to c:\Users\Dell\Desktop\IDP\engineer_a\.agents\tasks\lipika-eval-results.md AND print a concise stdout summary (actual per-script counts + headline accuracies). Support a fast smoke mode via the --min-per-script/--per-script-cap flags.

VERIFY-level only (the full multi-minute run is left to the human, Phase 3 STOP): confirm the script parses, imports without torch/fontrecog, and optionally runs a tiny smoke (--min-per-script 2 --per-script-cap 3).
acceptance_criteria: scripts/eval_lipika_crops.py exists, parses, and imports WITHOUT importing torch or fontrecog.

Auto-manifest maps the 12 dataset language folders to scripts via the authoritative table and adds the 5 English PDFs as latin; unmappable folders/PDFs are listed and skipped, never labelled by lipika/VLM.
The script defines the three strategies A/B/C and runs both fp32 and int8 sessions (reusing one session per model), collapsing the three 'other' label slots.
A tiny smoke run (--min-per-script 2 --per-script-cap 3) produces .agents/tasks/lipika-eval-results.md and prints a stdout summary without error (models present).
